title: Flashcards: Ray-finned fishes, families
intro: Flip each card about ray-finned fishes. Mark the ones you knew; the others come back sooner. Every answer shows its source.

cards.front: To which family does the Persian sturgeon (Acipenser persicus) belong?
cards.explain: The Persian sturgeon belongs to the family sturgeon.

cards.front: To which family does the Climbing perch (Anabas testudineus) belong?
cards.explain: The Climbing perch belongs to the family Anabantidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Japanese Eel (Anguilla japonica) belong?
cards.explain: The Japanese Eel belongs to the family Anguillidae.

cards.front: To which family does the goldfish (Carassius auratus) belong?
cards.explain: The goldfish belongs to the family Cyprinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Zebra danio (Danio rerio) belong?
cards.explain: The Zebra danio belongs to the family Danionidae.

cards.front: To which family does the European anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus) belong?
cards.explain: The European anchovy belongs to the family Engraulidae.

cards.front: To which family does the red-tailed black shark (Epalzeorhynchos bicolor) belong?
cards.explain: The red-tailed black shark belongs to the family Cyprinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Atlantic goliath grouper (Epinephelus itajara) belong?
cards.explain: The Atlantic goliath grouper belongs to the family Serranidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Long-snouted seahorse (Hippocampus guttulatus) belong?
cards.explain: The Long-snouted seahorse belongs to the family Syngnathidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Giant Tigerfish (Hydrocynus goliath) belong?
cards.explain: The Giant Tigerfish belongs to the family Alestidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Japanese rice fish (Oryzias latipes) belong?
cards.explain: The Japanese rice fish belongs to the family Adrianichthyidae.

cards.front: To which family does the giant pangasius (Pangasius sanitwongsei) belong?
cards.explain: The giant pangasius belongs to the family Pangasiidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Ziege (Pelecus cultratus) belong?
cards.explain: The Ziege belongs to the family Cyprinidae.

cards.front: To which family does the Reef triggerfish (Rhinecanthus rectangulus) belong?
cards.explain: The Reef triggerfish belongs to the family triggerfish.

cards.front: To which family does the swordfish (Xiphias gladius) belong?
cards.explain: The swordfish belongs to the family Xiphiidae.

cards.front: To which family does the yellow tang (Zebrasoma flavescens) belong?
cards.explain: The yellow tang belongs to the family Acanthuridae.
